record.description: A compact digital kitchen scale from Kiaitre with a 5000 g capacity and 1 g precision. It has a tare function that subtracts container weight, switches between g, kg, lb, oz and ml, and runs on USB charging or two AAA batteries, which are included.
record.long_description: The Kiaitre Digital Food Scale is a compact kitchen scale built for everyday measuring. Its brushed stainless steel platform sits neatly on a modern counter and wipes clean easily. The scale weighs up to 5000 grams, about 11 pounds, and reads in steps of 1 gram or 0.04 ounces, which suits both cooking and baking. The tare function resets the display once a bowl or container is placed on the platform, so you weigh only the ingredients. One button handles power and tare, while a second button switches between grams, kilograms, pounds, ounces and milliliters, making it easier to follow recipes written in different units. The large LCD shows the reading clearly and also signals low battery and overload. You can power it with USB charging or two AAA batteries, and both batteries are included. To save energy, it switches off automatically after three minutes. For the most accurate results, place it on a flat, level surface. It is also useful for portion control when you want to measure servings before eating.
record.meta_description: Kiaitre digital kitchen scale with a brushed stainless platform, weighing up to 5000 g in 1 g steps. Tare function, USB charging or AAA batteries.
record.seo_title: Kiaitre Digital Food Scale, 5000g Kitchen Scale with Tare

record.description: An automatic table tennis training robot from ZXMOTO that feeds balls for solo practice. It includes a catch net, holds about 120 standard 40mm balls, and lets you adjust frequency, spin direction, and placement to suit your style.
record.long_description: The ZXMOTO Table Tennis Robot is an automatic ping pong training machine for players who want to practice without a partner. It feeds balls across the table so you can work on returns, footwork, and timing at your own pace. The frequency setting controls how often balls arrive, so you can start slowly and increase the tempo as your game improves. A spin direction control lets you set the machine to the type of spin you want to handle, which helps you train for the shots you face most. The ball container holds about 120 balls, and the machine is designed for 40mm (1.57 inch) international standard balls, which the listing recommends for best results. A catch net is included to collect balls that miss, helping keep your practice area tidy. You can also position the robot to suit your preferred setup and training space. It is a practical option for building consistency, reaction speed, and confidence at the table on your own schedule.
record.meta_description: Practice ping pong solo with the ZXMOTO automatic table tennis robot. Adjust frequency and spin, and collect balls in the included catch net.
record.seo_title: ZXMOTO Table Tennis Robot with Catch Net for Training

record.description: A cordless 7-1/4-inch circular saw from DEWALT's FLEXVOLT ADVANTAGE line, running on 20V MAX batteries. It has a brushless motor turning at 5,500 RPM, an electric brake that stops the blade when the trigger is released, and is sold as a tool only, without battery or charger.

The DEWALT FLEXVOLT ADVANTAGE DCS573B is a 7-1/4-inch cordless circular saw built for jobs where a cord would get in the way. record.description: The Pool Blaster Aqua Broom is a cordless, battery-powered vacuum for spas, hot tubs, and small pools. It targets sand, silt, and dirt, and its patented retention valve helps keep debris from returning to the water.
record.long_description:
The Pool Blaster Aqua Broom is a cordless vacuum made for cleaning spas, hot tubs, small pools, and tight spaces. It is designed to pick up sand, silt, and everyday dirt in inground, above-ground, and inflatable pools as well as spa basins.

Power comes from five D-cell batteries, and the unit is designed to run for up to three hours on that set. Operation is simple: twist the switch to turn it on. There is no forced-air system, pump, or water hookup to set up before you start.

The Aqua Broom weighs under two pounds, so it is easy to handle by hand around steps, seats, and corners. For reaching farther, it attaches to any standard telescopic pool pole through the included pole adapter. The pole itself is not included.

A patented retention valve is designed to keep collected debris from flowing back into the water. The package includes an all-purpose filter bag and disposable micro-filter bags for finer material, along with the pole adapter.

Once connected, routes can be downloaded and rides uploaded automatically to compatible third-party services, including Strava, Ride With GPS, Komoot, Singletracks, MTB Project, and Best Bike Split.

Build a route and the unit shows pop-up messages and LED turn-by-turn prompts on screen, so you can keep your attention on the road or trail. It also integrates with Strava Live Segments, showing your progress against segments and offering a final push toward your goals.

The Bolt carries an IPX7 rating, meaning it is waterproof up to 5 feet, and it draws on GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo, and QZSS satellite systems for positioning. Battery life is rated at 15 hours. The box includes the ELEMNT Bolt, an integrated aero out-front mount, a stem mount, and a charging cable, so you have mounting options ready from the start. It is finished in Stealth Black.

This model suits players who want an amplified baritone with a solid top and a distinctive ebony-accented build. It works for solo performance, accompaniment, or playing with a band. Whether you are moving up from a smaller ukulele or adding a baritone to your collection, it offers a full, resonant sound and the convenience of onboard amplification in one instrument.

record.description: A unisex short sleeve tee in a retail fit, fitted at the bicep. It is made from 4.2 oz Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, with side seams, shoulder taping, and a tear-away label. Fiber blends vary by color.

Construction includes side seams and shoulder taping, which add reinforcement at the shoulders. A tear-away label at the neck makes it easy to remove the tag after purchase.

Because the sizing is unisex, the tee is offered in one size range for men and women, so you can choose based on the chest and length you prefer. It works well worn alone, layered under a jacket, or as a base for printing, and offers a classic, dependable silhouette.
record.meta_description: Shop the Bella+Canvas Heather Short Sleeve Tee: unisex retail fit, 4.2 oz Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, side seams and shoulder taping.

record.description: A 300-watt loop ignitor replacement for Quadrafire pellet stoves, rated for 120V AC power. Sold as Mt. Vernon AE part number SRV7000-647 and listed as made in the USA.
record.long_description: This replacement loop ignitor is designed for Quadrafire pellet stoves and is rated at 300 watts on 120V AC power. It is sold under Mt. Vernon AE part number SRV7000-647 and is meant to take the place of a worn or failed igniter in a compatible stove. The ignitor helps light the pellets at startup, so a working unit is needed for the stove to start properly. According to the listing, the part is made in the USA, and the seller notes that technical support is available for questions about it. Before ordering, check your stove model and confirm that the part number matches the original component, since compatibility is listed for Quadrafire pellet stoves only. Installation should follow your stove's service manual, and the stove should be unplugged and fully cooled before any work begins. Replacing a faulty ignitor can help restore normal ignition when a stove fails to light.
record.meta_description: Replacement 300 watt, 120V AC loop ignitor for Quadrafire pellet stoves. Mt. Vernon AE part SRV7000-647, listed as made in the USA.

Give everyday meals a more considered look with this set of four round serving plates from RoRo. Each piece measures 11 inches across and is made from plantation-grown acacia, a hardwood. record.meta_description: Set of four 11-inch round acacia wood serving plates and chargers from RoRo, with a small protective lip and water-based shellac lacquer finish.

record.description: A plastic ten-pin bowling set from Champion Sports with ten pins, capped holes for adding sand, and a set-up sheet and score pad. Suited to practice, school PE classes, and backyard play on multiple surfaces.
record.long_description:
Bring the ten-pin game home or to the gym with this plastic bowling set from Champion Sports. The set includes ten pins, the same count used in professional bowling, so players can practice the standard formation. It suits school physical education classes, recreation rooms, and backyard gatherings, and it is designed for use on several surfaces, so you can set up on a lawn, a patio, or indoor floors.

Wind and slightly uneven ground can throw off a game, so each pin has a half-inch capped hole. Remove the cap and add sand to weigh the pin down, helping it stay in place through repeated rounds. Beginners can use the set to build aim, control, and technique before moving to a bowling alley.

The package includes a set-up sheet that shows how to arrange the pins and a score pad for tracking results. Players of different ages can join in, making it a simple option for family game nights, kids' birthday parties, or vacation fun. It gives groups an easy way to enjoy a classic game together.
record.meta_description: Champion Sports 10-pin plastic bowling set for practice, kids, and backyard games. Add sand to pins for stability; includes set-up sheet and score pad.

record.description: A 48-inch LED aquarium light for tanks about 46 to 54 inches wide, suited to freshwater and saltwater setups. It runs at 38W on a 12V adapter and offers white, blue, red and green LEDs in a colorful daytime mode and a blue-only night mode.
record.long_description: The JOYHILL full spectrum aquarium light is a 48-inch LED fixture made for tanks roughly 46 to 54 inches wide, and the listing says it works in both freshwater and saltwater aquariums. It draws 38W through a 12V, 4A power supply and uses 2835 LEDs in white, blue, red and green. The housing is aluminum alloy, which the listing describes as lightweight, durable and resistant to oxidation. Two extendable brackets let you adjust the length to fit your tank, so the light can rest on the top of the aquarium. Two lighting modes are included. The colorful mode mixes white, blue, red and green for daytime viewing, while the blue-only lunar mode gives a cool glow for evening. The listing states the fixture is designed for use over a glass cover or acrylic top, not over open water. Dimensions without brackets are 117.5 by 10 by 5 cm, and the power cord measures 1.5 m. The package includes the light, two brackets and the power supply. The listing recommends running the light for about 8 to 10 hours a day and performing several water changes before adding new lighting to reduce nutrients in the water.
record.meta_description: JOYHILL 48-inch aquarium LED light, 38W with white, blue, red and green LEDs, extendable brackets and a 12V adapter. Fits tanks 46 to 54 inches wide.

record.description: A 50 ft brown RG-316 coaxial cable with a 50 ohm impedance, thin 0.1 inch diameter, and flexible Teflon jacket. Its silver-plated copper stranded conductor and braid support frequencies up to 6 GHz, suited to ham radio, Wi-Fi, and antenna builds.
record.long_description:
The XRDS-RF RG-316 coax cable arrives in a 50 foot length, giving you room for antenna feeds, interconnects, and bench builds. Its miniature design measures about 0.1 inch across, so it fits through tight spaces and bends easily. With a 50 ohm impedance and a minimum install bend radius of 0.53 inch, it suits many radio setups.

The stranded inner conductor and braid are both silver-plated copper, a combination the listing says keeps signal loss low up to 6 GHz. The brown Teflon jacket is flexible and rated for operating temperatures from -55 to +200 C, and the listing notes it can handle harsh outdoor conditions. Maximum tensile strength is listed at 12.2 pounds.

Because the cable is lightweight and pliable, it works for ham radio, VHF and UHF work, balun and coax capacitor projects, and antenna builds. The listing also names 4G LTE, ADS-B, and Wi-Fi applications. You can crimp SMA or other connectors onto the ends to match your equipment. Check connector and adapter requirements before you start.
record.meta_description: Shop the XRDS-RF 50 ft RG-316 coax: thin, flexible 50 ohm cable with silver-plated copper conductors, rated to 6 GHz for radio and antenna builds.
record.seo_title: XRDS-RF RG-316 50 ft Thin Flexible Coax Cable

record.description: A remote training collar for dogs weighing 10 pounds and up, with a 1/2-mile range, 100 intensity levels, and a fully waterproof collar and receiver. It offers Momentary Nick, Constant, and Pager Vibration modes and includes a PetsTEK clicker for positive reinforcement.

A front-facing rheostat dial provides 100 intensity levels across low to medium power, letting you fine-tune stimulation for sensitive dogs. Choose from Momentary Nick, Constant, or Pager Vibration Only modes. The collar and receiver are fully waterproof, and the batteries recharge in about 2 hours and shut off automatically.

The package includes the receiver, transmitter, charger with splitter cable, owner's manual, and a PetsTEK training clicker. Pair the clicker with treats to reward good behavior.

Use the collar humanely. Start with no more than 2 hours of wear per day, and never exceed 10 hours in a day, to avoid skin irritation from the contact points. The device is for dogs only, is not recommended for puppies under 4 months, and should be kept away from children. If your dog becomes aggressive during training, seek professional help.

record.description: Rallt hammock tree straps are two 10-foot, non-stretch polyester straps with 18 daisy-chain loops each, for 36 total. They come with two aluminum gate carabiners and reflective tracers for night setup. Each strap packs small and weighs 11.7 ounces with its stuff sack.
record.long_description:
The Rallt Hammock Tree Straps give you a 20-foot suspension system made from two 10-foot straps of 3/4-inch tubular polyester webbing. Polyester does not stretch, so your hammock stays where you hung it, unlike nylon straps that tend to loosen. Each strap has 18 loops, giving you 36 attachment points to fine-tune your hang and fit trees of different sizes.

Setup uses a daisy-chain loop system rather than knots. Wrap a strap around the tree, then clip your hammock's carabiner into one of the loops. Reflective tracers make the straps easier to find and set up after dark. Two aluminum wire gate carabiners are included.

The straps are rated for a combined breaking strength of more than 2,000 pounds. Length is the main advantage: each strap can span trees set far apart, and you can join straps together for even greater distances. They also suit posts, large rocks, roof racks, boat masts, and docks, so they are useful beyond camping.

At 11.7 ounces with its stuff sack, the kit packs down to about 4 by 4 by 1.5 inches, so it fits easily in a backpack for hiking or backcountry trips.
record.meta_description: Rallt 20-foot hammock tree straps with 36 loops, non-stretch polyester, and two carabiners. Lightweight at 11.7 oz and quick to set up at camp.
record.seo_title: Rallt Hammock Tree Straps, 20 ft Suspension Kit

record.description: A slim, lightweight, waterproof multi-function collar from High Tech Pet for dog fence systems. It works with Humane Contain X-10 electronic fences, Power Pet doors, Sound Barrier and Yard Barrier sonic fences, and Radio Mat kits. Its rechargeable battery is designed never to need replacing.
record.long_description:
The High Tech Pet RX-10 is a multi-function collar built for use with several dog containment and deterrent systems. It is compatible with the Humane Contain X-10 electronic fence, Power Pet electronic doors, Sound Barrier and Yard Barrier sonic fences, and Radio Mat pet deterrent kits, so one collar can serve across these setups. A single RX-10 can replace the need for a dog to wear multiple collars.

The collar is extremely slim and lightweight, designed with pet comfort in mind, and it is waterproof. Its rechargeable battery is intended to eliminate the need for battery replacement. The battery takes about three hours to recharge.

For households with more than one dog, additional RX-10 collars can be added to a Humane Contain X-10 electronic fence. This allows containment of any number of dogs, with each dog wearing its own collar. Because it works across several compatible systems, the RX-10 suits owners who want one collar style for their existing or planned containment setup. Check your specific system's requirements to confirm compatibility before purchase.
record.meta_description: Slim, waterproof RX-10 collar by High Tech Pet for Humane Contain X-10, Power Pet doors, sonic fences and Radio Mat kits. Rechargeable battery.
record.seo_title: High Tech Pet RX-10 Multi-Function Dog Collar

record.description: Luminex by PowerSpa 7-color LED shower head combo with an overhead head and removable handheld, offering 24 water patterns. The LEDs cycle through seven colors and run on water flow, so no batteries are needed.
record.long_description:
The Luminex by PowerSpa 7-Color LED Shower Head Combo pairs an overhead showerhead with a handheld shower, so you can use either one alone or both together. Together they offer 24 full and combined water patterns. Each head has a 4-inch face and four settings: Rain, Massage, Rain with Massage, and a Pause mode for saving water. Both heads angle to suit your position.

The LED lights cycle through seven colors every few seconds, blending gradually from one to the next. Water flow powers them, so there are no batteries to replace. Each head uses a turbine and air-jet design that mixes air into the flow through 48 elastic nozzles. The nozzles can be rubbed clean and are designed to resist clogging.

The handheld shower lifts off its overhead bracket for close-up use. A patented 3-way water diverter with an anti-swivel lock nut switches between the heads. The extra-flexible 5-foot stainless steel hose has solid brass conical nuts that hand-tighten without tools. It connects to a standard overhead shower arm in minutes.

Luminex includes a 1-year limited warranty and US-based live customer service.
record.meta_description: Luminex 7-color LED shower head combo with 24 water patterns, powered by running water with no batteries. Includes a 4-inch face and removable handheld.
record.seo_title: Luminex by PowerSpa 7-Color LED Shower Head Combo

record.description: A men's dive-style sport watch from Casio with a 43 mm resin case, resin buckle band, and mineral dial window. It has a three-hand analog display, day and date, a Japanese quartz movement, and 100 m water resistance for swimming and snorkeling.
record.long_description: The Casio MRW200H-3BV is a men's sport watch with a dive-inspired look, built around a 43 mm resin case that keeps the weight light for everyday wear. Its three-hand analog dial shows the time, with a day and date display for quick reference, and a mineral dial window protects the face. The resin band secures with a buckle closure, giving a simple, comfortable fit on the wrist. A Japanese quartz movement powers the watch, with a stated accuracy of plus or minus 20 seconds per month. The listed battery is an SR626SW, which Casio rates at roughly three years of life. Water resistance is rated to 100 m (330 ft), which suits swimming and snorkeling. It is not intended for scuba diving, so keep that limit in mind when choosing where to wear it. The listing notes that some models include a 12/24 hour index, so check the specifics of the version you are buying. Overall, this is a practical, low-maintenance watch for daily wear, recreation in the water, and anyone who wants a durable resin sports watch.
record.meta_description: Casio's MRW200H-3BV men's sport watch has a 43 mm resin case, resin buckle band, day and date display, and 100 m water resistance for swimming.
record.seo_title: Casio MRW200H-3BV Men's Dive-Style Resin Sport Watch

record.description: A set of three black Molex Mini-Fit Jr. two-circuit connectors with a 4.20mm (.0165") pitch. Each set comes with crimp pins and sockets for 18-24 AWG wire, and the contacts are rated for a maximum of 9.0A.
record.long_description:
This Molex Mini-Fit Jr. kit gives you three black two-circuit connectors with a 4.20mm (.0165") mating pitch, suited to projects that need a compact, reliable wire-to-wire or board connection. Each completed set pairs a male and a female housing, so you can join leads without assembling the shells yourself. The housings are made of polyamide, and the connectors are rated for operating temperatures from -40°C to +105°C.

The contacts are brass with tin plating and use a crimp style termination for wire sized 18-24 AWG. The listed maximum is 9.0A per contact and 600V, and the wire insulation diameter should fall between 1.30mm and 3.10mm. The kit includes extra pins and sockets beyond the connector count, which helps if a crimp needs to be redone.

The terminals are supplied on strip or reel packaging, which keeps them organized and makes them easier to handle while you feed them into a crimping tool. This kit is a practical choice for hobbyists, prototypes, and small builds that call for Mini-Fit Jr. parts.
record.meta_description: Molex Mini-Fit Jr black 2-circuit connector set, 4.20mm pitch, for 18-24 AWG wire. Three completed sets with crimp pins and sockets, rated 9.0A per contact.
record.seo_title: Molex Mini-Fit Jr 2-Pin Connector Set, 4.20mm Pitch

Compared with a traditional wallet, it is much thinner, so it sits comfortably in a pocket without creating a bulky back pocket. Elastic webbing expands to hold up to 12 cards, keeping everyday cards together in one compact case.

RFID blocking is built in to help keep credit cards, debit cards, passports, and driver's licenses away from contactless scanning devices. A spring steel money clip lets you carry cash, business cards, or RFID-enabled cards, so you can switch between a clip and a card holder depending on the day. The metal finish gives the wallet a smooth, solid feel in the hand.

Each wallet comes in gift box packaging, which protects it in storage and makes it an easy present for a friend, partner, or family member, or a treat for yourself.
record.meta_description: A slim black metal wallet for men with RFID blocking, a spring steel money clip, and room for up to 12 cards. Made of aviation aluminum and stainless steel.

record.description: A thermal receipt printer made for Safescan money counters, printing the total counting result broken down by denomination. It works with Safescan 6165, 6185, 2885-S and 2985-SX models and uses standard thermal print paper. Quick and easy to use.
record.long_description:
The Safescan TP-230 is a thermal receipt printer designed to work alongside Safescan money counters. After a count, it prints the total counting result for each denomination, giving you a clear paper record of what was counted. It is built to pair with the Safescan 6165, 6185, 2885-S and 2985-SX models, so it can fit into a counting setup you already use.

Printing uses standard thermal print paper, so there is no ink or toner to buy or replace. Setup and everyday use are kept straightforward, so staff can produce a printout without adding complicated steps to the counting routine.

This printer may be useful in cash handling environments such as shops, banks, and offices where counts need to be documented and checked. Because each denomination is listed separately, reviewing a batch of notes or coins against the recorded total becomes easier. It is intended for use with the compatible Safescan counters listed above, so check your model number before purchasing to confirm compatibility.
record.meta_description: Print counting totals per denomination with the Safescan TP-230 thermal receipt printer. Works with Safescan 6165, 6185, 2885-S and 2985-SX counters.
record.seo_title: Safescan TP-230 Thermal Receipt Printer for Money Counters

record.description: Hedume 12-pack of 4 oz empty, refillable cobalt blue glass spray bottles, each with a fine mist sprayer and dust cap. Suited to diluted essential oils, witch hazel, air freshener, deodorant and household cleaners. The blue glass helps shield contents from UV light.

Keep small batches of homemade blends ready to use with this set of twelve 4 oz cobalt blue glass spray bottles from Hedume. Each bottle arrives empty and can be refilled as often as you need. Every one comes fitted with a fine mist sprayer and a dust cap to keep the nozzle clean between uses.

The solid cobalt blue glass is designed to help protect light-sensitive liquids from ultraviolet degradation, which matters for essential oils that can lose potency when exposed to sunlight. The glass is also described as unaffected by strong oils such as citrus. The bottles are leak proof, odourless, and free of BPA and lead.

record.description: The Bosch HC5051 is a 1-inch by 21-inch SDS-max rotary hammer bit with a solid carbide head for drilling masonry and concrete. It fits SDS-max hammers and Hilti hammers with TE-Y or TE-FY shanks. A centric tip is designed to guide the bit through hard and reinforced concrete, and inclined side cutters are meant to speed cutting.
record.long_description:
The Bosch HC5051 is a 21-inch SDS-max rotary hammer bit with a 1-inch diameter, built for drilling into concrete and masonry. Its solid carbide head is meant to hold up to repeated use on tough materials. Bosch says the bit stays sharp longer than many competing bits, so it can drill more holes between replacements.

The bit is designed to work with SDS-max rotary hammers and with Hilti hammers that use TE-Y or TE-FY shanks, which makes it a practical choice for jobs with mixed equipment. A centric tip helps keep the bit on course when it reaches hard or reinforced concrete, where wandering can be a problem. Inclined side cutters have an aggressive edge that aims to clear material quickly and speed up drilling.

This bit suits contractors and serious DIY users who need deep, large-diameter holes in concrete, block, or brick. Check that your hammer uses an SDS-max or compatible Hilti shank before purchasing.
record.meta_description: Bosch HC5051 SDS-max carbide rotary hammer bit, 1 in. diameter by 21 in. long, for drilling concrete and masonry. Fits SDS-max and Hilti TE-Y/TE-FY hammers.

record.description: A black metal lapel clip-on condenser microphone with a 3.5mm plug, designed to work with phones, laptops and computers. Omnidirectional pickup, about 150 cm total length with a 142 cm cable, and a 20 Hz to 20 kHz frequency range.

record.description: SagsAway is a foam cushion repair insert that fits inside the zippered cover of a sagging sofa, loveseat, or chair seat to restore its firmness and shape. It comes in two thicknesses, can be cut to size, and is made in the USA. Each kit repairs one cushion.
record.long_description:
The SagsAway Sagging Cushion Repair Insert is a foam solution for sofa, loveseat, and chair seats that have lost their shape. Rather than replacing a cushion core, you slip the flexible, dense foam insert inside the zippered cushion cover, where it helps restore thickness, comfort, and a fuller appearance. Inserts come in two thicknesses, including a 1.5 inch Extreme version, and can be cut to fit cushions of any size, so you can match the padding to each seat's needs.

Before buying, measure your sag the way you actually sit. The cushion needs at least 2 inches of remaining foam to compress effectively. If it has less, the foam or the spring deck may be too weak for this repair. The insert conforms to the support beneath it, but it cannot make up for a weak spring deck. Its 9-ounce (270 ml) capacity suits everyday drinks, and the blue and green monster-themed design adds a playful touch at snack and drink time. The cup is recommended for babies 9 months and up and is made without BPA.

Assembly is straightforward, and the cup is dishwasher safe, so cleanup can fit easily into a busy daily routine for parents and caregivers.
record.meta_description: Dr. Brown's 9 oz BPA-free toddler cup with a removable one-piece silicone spout and attached lid. Dishwasher safe, recommended for babies 9 months and up.

record.description: Dove-colored open weave linen blend curtain panels sold as a set of two, each 52 by 84 inches with eight nickel grommets. They filter daylight softly while offering some privacy, and fit rods up to 1 1/4 inches.
record.long_description:
Bring a relaxed, natural touch to your windows with these dove-toned curtain panels from H.VERSAILTEX. Woven from open weave linen blend, the fabric has a soft, slightly textured look that suits rustic, farmhouse, and contemporary rooms alike.

Each order includes two panels, each 52 inches wide by 84 inches long. Eight nickel grommets line the top of every panel, and the header and hem measure about 4 and 2 inches. The grommets fit rods up to 1 1/4 inches across.

The semi-sheer weave lets daylight in softly while keeping the room out of clear view from outside, so spaces stay bright and private. The fabric is not see-through, and it gives a light, finished look to living rooms and bedrooms.

Care is simple: machine wash in cold water, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry on low, and iron on a warm setting as needed. The listing recommends panels about two to three times the width of your window for a fuller look.
record.meta_description: Soft open weave linen blend grommet curtains in dove, sold as a pair of 52 x 84 inch panels. Filter daylight with a natural, airy look for any room.

record.long_description:
The Home Life 6-Inch Twin Size Spring Mattress offers a compact, low-profile sleep surface in a soft mint finish. Its support core uses independently pocketed spring coils, with each coil wrapped separately so it can respond to the body on its own. The coils are 15-gauge, a detail that helps define the support structure of the mattress. Above the coils, layers of foam add a comfort layer intended to ease pressure and provide a more cushioned feel.

At six inches thick, this mattress is lower in profile than many standard mattresses, which may suit smaller bed frames, platform beds, or rooms where height is a concern. The twin size fits single beds, guest rooms, dorms, and children's rooms. The seller describes the mattress as more comfortable than most standard 8 to 10 inch mattresses and says it is quiet, with no squeaking. These are the seller's claims, so compare them with your own expectations before buying.

For shipping, the mattress arrives compressed and rolled, which makes it easier to carry and deliver. Allow it to unroll and expand fully before use. Check the product dimensions and any frame requirements in the listing to confirm it suits your setup.
record.meta_description: Home Life 6-inch twin spring mattress in mint with independently pocketed 15-gauge coils and layered foam. Ships compressed and rolled for easy delivery.
record.seo_title: Home Life 6-Inch Twin Spring Mattress, Mint

record.description: KILZ Premium is a white water-based latex primer and sealer sold in a 5-gallon bucket for interior and exterior use. It blocks stains, hides previous colors, and bonds to drywall, plaster, woodwork, paneling, masonry, and brick. Mildewcide protection helps resist mildew and mold.
record.long_description:
KILZ Premium High-Hide Stain Blocking Latex Primer/Sealer is a water-based white primer built to tackle tough surface problems before you paint. Its stain-blocking formula seals the surface, helps you reach an even finish, and covers stains along with previous colors, which makes it a practical choice when you are switching to a lighter or different shade.

The product bonds well to most interior and exterior surfaces, including drywall, plaster, woodwork, paneling, masonry, and brick. Its consistency is meant to spread smoothly and level out, sealing porous areas and filling small imperfections caused by texture or uneven porosity. Mildewcide protection helps guard against mildew and mold, so it suits humid spaces such as bathrooms and laundry rooms.

It works well for color changes and for sealing light to medium stains. For heavier stains, the manufacturer suggests considering KILZ Max primer instead.

This 5-gallon bucket is sized for larger jobs. Coverage is roughly 300 to 400 square feet per gallon, depending on the surface.
record.meta_description: KILZ Premium white latex primer/sealer blocks stains and hides old colors on interior and exterior drywall, wood, masonry and brick.
record.seo_title: KILZ Premium Stain Blocking Latex Primer 5 Gal White

record.description: A black vegan leather case for the Samsung Galaxy S6 with an EMF and RFID blocking front flap, a built-in wallet holding up to four cards plus cash, and a kickstand for hands-free viewing.
record.long_description:
The SafeSleeve Galaxy S6 case is built for people who want to carry their phone with a bit more privacy and convenience. Its front flap contains a shielding layer that the maker describes as EMF and RFID blocking, and the listing cites FCC-accredited lab testing indicating it can block up to 99 percent of cell phone EMF radiation. The shielding is integrated into the flap rather than added as a separate piece, so the case remains a single unit.

The same flap doubles as a full wallet. Four credit or business cards fit in the card area, with room for cash and a few additional documents, all kept behind the RFID-blocking material. Because the wallet attaches to the phone, you carry one item instead of two.

A built-in kickstand lets you prop the phone up for reading, watching videos, or watching movies, and you can use it hands-free on a nearby flat surface.

The exterior is vegan leather, which gives a clean, professional finish without animal products. It suits both men and women and is made specifically for the Samsung Galaxy S6. Available in black.
record.meta_description: Protect your Samsung Galaxy S6 with SafeSleeve's black vegan leather case: EMF and RFID blocking front flap, four-card wallet, and built-in kickstand.
record.seo_title: SafeSleeve Galaxy S6 EMF Wallet Case, Black Vegan Leather

record.description: Novostella 20ft tunable white LED strip kit with 720 2835 LEDs, adjustable from 3000K warm white to 6000K daylight. record.long_description:
The Novostella 20ft tunable white LED strip kit gives you a flexible run of 720 2835 LEDs across six metres. You can shift the light between warm white at 3000K, neutral white at 4500K and daylight at 6000K, and ten brightness levels let you set the mood for a bedroom, kitchen or workspace. The included 360-degree RF remote is meant to work without being aimed at the strip, and the listing says its signal can pass through walls, doors and cabinets.

Installation is straightforward. Each strip has a self-adhesive backing for quick application, and the kit includes 12 mounting brackets with screws if you prefer a more secure fixing. The package contains the strips, a UL-listed 100-240V AC power adapter, a controller cable and the remote. The strip runs on 24V DC, and the listing describes low heat output and good heat dissipation.

Typical uses include under-cabinet lighting, behind mirrors, along TV units, in stairways, and for party or wedding decor. The strip is not waterproof, so it suits dry indoor spaces. The listed lifespan is 50,000 hours. The seller offers a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 12-month warranty.
record.meta_description: Novostella 20ft tunable white LED strip kit: 720 LEDs dimmable from 3000K warm white to 6000K daylight, with a 360° RF remote and self-adhesive backing.
record.seo_title: Novostella 20ft Tunable White LED Strip Light Kit

Protect the display of your Samsung Galaxy Watch Active or Active 2 (40mm) with this clear TPU screen protector from UniqueMe. The flexible film is designed to follow the watch's edges for broad screen coverage, including on curved areas, and it is sold as a multi-pack so you have spares on hand.

The surface uses an oleophobic coating that is meant to resist everyday fingerprints and dust, helping the screen stay clearer between cleanings. The film is also described as self-healing, with the aim of smoothing out small scratches and bubbles over time.

record.description: A brushed stainless steel hand towel bar with a U-shaped rail for small and medium towels, plus two included towel hooks. Mounts with self-adhesive backing, no drilling needed. Made of 304 stainless steel, it holds up to 11 lbs.
record.long_description: The Yosemy hand towel holder gives small and medium hand and dish towels a handy place to hang without drilling into your walls. Its U-shaped bar measures 7.67 inches (19.5 cm) long and is made from 304 stainless steel with a brushed finish. The listing describes the material as rustproof and waterproof, so it is intended for use in bathrooms and kitchens. The holder is rated for a maximum load of 11 lbs (5 kg). It can be mounted on a wall or on the side of a cabinet or closet door, and it suits kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, and RVs. The package includes one towel holder and two towel hooks. The hooks can hold hats, robes, coats, keys, or umbrellas, and they can also be used for a razor or plug. Installation uses the self-adhesive backing, so no tools are required. Choose a flat, smooth, clean, and dry surface such as ceramic tile, marble, metal, or glass. The adhesive is not suitable for wallpaper, painted walls, or surfaces with dust or water. Clean and dry the surface, remove the protective film, and press the holder firmly in place. Wait 48 hours before hanging anything on it.
record.meta_description: Yosemy self-adhesive hand towel holder in brushed 304 stainless steel, 7.67 inches long, with two towel hooks included. No drill; holds up to 11 lbs.
record.seo_title: Yosemy Hand Towel Holder, 304 Stainless Steel Wall Bar
